description.message: Screenshots of an area or a whole page with arrows, text and blur. Save images as PNG or JPG, Alt+click to zoom into pixels.

saveFailed.message: Snapt could not save this image: $ERROR$

selectHint.message: Drag to select an area, or click an element. Enter takes the whole view, Esc cancels.

captureFailed.message: Snapt could not take the screenshot: $ERROR$

captureGone.message: This screenshot is no longer available. Take a new one from the Snapt button.

screenHint.message: Pick a screen or a window in the browser's sharing dialog. Snapt takes one frame and stops sharing right away; nothing leaves your computer.

screenCancelled.message: Nothing was picked. Try again when you are ready.

hintPage.message: Scrolled and glued into one image

tipLightbox.message: Alt+click any image to zoom in. Right-click it to save as PNG or JPG.

optHeroText.message: An area, the visible part or the whole page, then arrows, text and blur in the same editor as the desktop app.

optShortcutsText.message: Take a screenshot without opening the popup. The browser keeps the keys, so you change them there.

optShortcutsFirefox.message: In Firefox: open about:addons, click the gear icon and pick Manage Extension Shortcuts.

featCaptureText.message: An area or a single element, the visible part, the whole scrolled page, or any screen and window.

featEditorText.message: Pen, arrows, shapes, marker, text, numbered steps, pixelate and blur. Copy, or save as PNG or JPG.

featSaveText.message: Right-click any image, WebP, AVIF and SVG included, and save it in a format every app opens.

featLightboxText.message: Alt+click an image to open it over the page. Zoom down to pixels, pan and rotate.

optPrivacy.message: Everything happens on your computer. Snapt has no servers, no accounts and no tracking.

optMoreText.message: Free and open source, like Snapt.

appDesktopText.message: The same editor for the whole screen: one key, select, annotate, done.

appLevelerText.message: Evens out the loudness of any video, so quiet dialogue and loud scenes sound alike.

appGlowText.message: Soft light in the colours of the picture around any video, like an LED strip behind a TV.
